task: Final research report synthesis: PPO explained variance diagnosis (Dodge PPO teacher)

sources_scope.used: The four notes files above, plus read-only checks of the frozen ppo.py lines 166-172 and 545-550 and its hash. training-metrics.jsonl was hashed only; its statistics are taken from the notes.
sources_scope.web_sources: Cited only from the notes' sources.json: SB3 utils.py and ppo.py, CleanRL ppo.py, GAE (1506.02438), PPG (2009.04416), Ilyas et al. (1811.02553), ICLR blog track implementation details. No new web research.
sources_scope.not_used: arXiv 2006.05990 (abstract only, no claim extracted); PPO paper 1707.06347 (not fetched).
sources_scope.limitations: Notes' sources were read by the researcher through WebFetch summaries, so excerpts are partly paraphrased, not verified verbatim. Some arXiv sources are abstract-only. The ICLR blog was read to 100000 of 101074 characters. Not a full literature review.

coordinator_qualifications_applied: EV scores rollout-time predictions against frozen GAE targets; residual equals GAE advantage up to rounding (ppo.py:171, 547-549); post-optimization logging does not make it a post-update fit metric; 'rollout-time predictions' used instead of 'previous update's critic'.
EV is insensitive to constant residual bias at fixed predictions and targets; no claim that minibatch advantage normalization removes critic bias from GAE.
Rejected 2*value_loss/(1-EV) reconstruction; target-variance collapse vs residual growth reported as unresolved; no 'data favor rising residual' claim.
Shared-trunk drift and critic under-optimization stated as plausible only; trunk gradient norm mixes actor and critic; KL is an epoch-end stopping threshold; no causal ranking.
Post-update EV >= 0.55 heuristic rejected as a healthy threshold or justification for long training.
Naive Monte Carlo EV on completed episodes in a 256-step rollout omitted from the recommendation (selection bias toward short episodes); delta V measured on the same frozen observations.

GAE lambda*gamma horizon (~18 decisions, ~73 raw frames) described as a weighting, not a planning limit; one narrow instrumentation step recommended with no pass threshold; resource and time cost noted.

No continuation from failed weights authorized; failed-run eligibility and identity checks unchanged; best/final continuation described as a future separately registered experiment requiring permitted lineage; research authorized and ran no experiment.

Evidence figures reported as given: EV first20 0.597973 to last20 0.317240; entropy 1.880125 to 1.745426; KL stop 230/384; best 64-seed D2 dev survival Q1=648.25, Q4=4508.8125, mean 2240 frames; score 3.5/46.59375/20.59375; best-of-24 selection on fixed development seeds, not held-out.
Source-access limits stated in the report (WebFetch summaries, PPO paper not fetched, abstract-only sources, ICLR blog truncation); another domain's KL<0.02 not adopted as a Dodge threshold.
actions_not_taken: No web research, nested agents, edits to source, metadata or ledger files, tests, ML or project imports, checkpoint decoding, gameplay, training or experiments. The four original notes files were not modified.
